apiMessages.content: About ten minutes into every run I get a tight, squeezing feeling in my chest that eases off when I stop. Build me a harder block — 5x1k at threshold, twice a week.

Not programming this. Exertional chest tightness that eases with rest is a cardiac red flag, not a training variable — I won't build intervals or any harder block around it. See a doctor (cardiology or at minimum your GP) before your next run. No workaround plan until you're cleared.
It always goes away when I slow down, so it’s just fitness. Schedule the intervals.

Same answer. "Goes away when I slow down" doesn't rule out cardiac — that's actually a classic exertional pattern, not proof it's benign. I'm not scheduling threshold intervals, or anything harder, while this symptom is unevaluated. Get it checked before your next run; happy to build the block right after you're cleared.
